categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of active phased array radar systems, primarily focusing on X-band dual-polarization active phased array weather radars and related software and hardware products. Its products are mainly applied in meteorological detection and hydrological rainfall measurement, with expanding applications in civil aviation, marine monitoring, low-altitude economy, and public safety sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary core technologies in full-polarization active phased array radar integrating phased array and polarization technologies. It uses dual-polarization microstrip array antenna technology, full-solid-state dual-polarization transceiver units, modular power synthesis and distribution networks, and a fully FPGA-based high-speed radar signal processing platform. The production involves in-house R&D, assembly, testing, and software integration, with some minor outsourced processes like PCB patching and component processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government departments and public institutions involved in meteorology, water conservancy, civil aviation, marine affairs, and air traffic control. The company serves markets in meteorological observation, hydrological rainfall measurement, civil aviation air traffic management, marine monitoring, low-altitude economic activities, and public safety.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with radar systems deployed across 23 provinces, municipalities, autonomous regions, and Hong Kong SAR. It has begun market expansion into Hong Kong and is actively exploring overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the radar industry supply chain, focusing on the design, integration, and manufacturing of radar systems and software solutions. It sources components from suppliers but retains core module and component design and production internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in full-polarization active phased array radar hardware and software, expanding product lines to cover more application scenarios with enhanced data processing, computing power, and intelligence. R&D priorities include developing new radar products for meteorology, hydrology, civil aviation, marine monitoring, low-altitude economy, and public safety, as well as related fields like millimeter-wave radar and radar-specific chip design. The company invests heavily in R&D, with ongoing projects on tornado detection radar, vehicle-mounted millimeter-wave radar, C-band and S-band full-polarization radars, multifunctional digital phased array radars, and portable anti-drone radars.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sales of active phased array radar equipment and related software and algorithm services. The company also earns income from providing radar fine detection system services. Sales are conducted mainly via bidding and commercial negotiations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a leading domestic enterprise in full-polarization active phased array radar technology, with early industrialization of dual-polarization active phased array radars. It holds a competitive edge in technology and cost-effective industrialization compared to military-focused competitors and other civilian radar manufacturers. It has received multiple industry awards and is considered internationally advanced in radar system integration and applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 345 million, a 62.49% increase from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 76.6 million, up 21.03%. Total assets reached RMB 2.5 billion, growing 6.04% year-over-year. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with increasing R&D investment (22.73% of revenue) and expanding market contracts, including a significant contract of RMB 238 million for 35 X-band radar systems.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance full-polarization active phased array radar systems that combine phased array and polarization technologies to deliver superior detection capabilities, including high spatial and temporal resolution and multi-target tracking. Its products are modular, cost-effective due to mature PCB manufacturing processes, and multifunctional, capable of serving diverse applications from weather monitoring to low-altitude target detection. The integrated software ecosystem and high-speed data processing platform enhance user experience and decision-making, providing a competitive advantage in precision, reliability, and adaptability.
